name: Click
long_description:
Click provides managed agents you can use with any model, without provisioning any infrastructure. Simply connect your tools and submit inputs - Click runs the agent and streams back results. 

Click handle all of the infrastructure, like harness, sandbox, browser, and web search. You can scale agentic workloads effortlessly without provisioning anything.

Ask your coding agent about useclick.ai/reference!

launches.title: Click - Research services inside Codex & Claude
launches.tagline: Live external context from professional & social platforms, marketplaces, financials, and more.
launches.body:
**TLDR:** Click is an MCP that provides extensive research connectors to give external context that the built-in web search misses.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110141&key=user_uploads/1995988/91aff538-41b1-4c8b-96eb-c1bf84bd5e47)

**Video:** <https://youtu.be/IgcAy86cPls>

**Problem:**

Click is largely motivated by a change in my own behavior:

Codex & Claude are amazing products. I live inside their surface now - using it more than my browser. It feels like home, to the point that I’m annoyed to have to leave. Most often, I’m stepping outside to do external-facing tasks, like researching my leads on LinkedIn or comparing flight options. I want my agents to do these tasks as well.

Currently, those can’t be completed because their gateway to the world (in-built web search) has limited access. Often the agent also asks to use the browser with a logged-in session, which I’m uncomfortable with.

So, I built the connector layer that I wish existed.

**Solution:**

Click’s MCP is a single installation that provides your agent with an ever-growing bundle of the best data connectors. The current set of connectors enable new use cases inside the chat, like:

* Lead research & enrichment
* Researching ad campaigns from competitors
* Analyzing sentiment around a topic across social media
* Planning travel with live fares & availability

**Team:**

I’m Aditya, the founder of Click. Previously, I helped build Ethereum, with a vision to create a platform that enables new kinds of applications. 

Now, I’m focusing on the next application platform - the AI chat surface. Click builds useful services that meet users right inside the conversation. I’m building one trusted service at a time, and research is the first one.
